correctness.rationale: For every n>=7 the parity-labelled orbit-cell chain complex is exact because stabilizers fix each occupied column individually. The cycle lattice has a free basis of signed triangle differences and all-positive tetrahedron boundaries. Both three-cell boundaries reduce by unimodular substitutions to the unsigned W_{2,4}(n-1) relations. Corollary 3 of arXiv:0709.3144 verifies all Smith factors for n-1>=6, and Euler characteristic gives the free top rank. The executable integer checker confirms the boundary presentation in four widths, including both stable test widths.
